name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's 'do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once' is correctly captured by the hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) — the ban ends once the door has been opened, and key_lost's definition already encodes the 'while the door is closed' condition. 'Reach the goal' is the hard Existence(at_goal). The machine's final state requires at_goal, and a key_lost before door_open is a hard failure, matching the task.

texts: The key is not lost before the door has been opened once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&!door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, !at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&!key_lost) -> u3
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&door_open) -> u3
(u2, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&!door_open&key_lost, u1) -> -10
